svg.title: Two Blacks and White
svg.desc: Interpretive vector study after the viewed reference. Approximate geometry; framing, wall, shadows and paint texture omitted. Museum-supplied Google Arts & Culture image: lower-left black rectangle, middle white square, upper-right black rectangle. Open stepped spaces remain transparent; the middle white panel is painted support.
